input.question: How can I see images in my mind and also hear my voice in my mind?
input.ground_truth: Neurology is very poorly understood, especially concerning things as broad and complex as imagination. You can because your brain has a means of hearing and seeing that is connected, but nonetheless distinct, from the actual sensory input of the eyes and ears.

Question: How can I see images in my mind and also hear my voice in my mind?

response.prediction:
Okay, let’s imagine you have a special TV inside your head. When you close your eyes and think about a picture—like your favorite toy or a puppy—you can sometimes see that picture in your mind, just like watching a tiny TV show inside your head!

Now, you also have a little radio in your head. If you think about singing a song or saying “hello” in your mind, you can “hear” your own voice inside your head, just like listening to the radio.

So, when you want to see a picture or hear your voice inside your head, you just close your eyes, think about what you want to see or say, and try to imagine it like a movie or a song playing in your mind!
